spec.situation_desc: sent a bank transfer that arrived days late, so they missed a rent payment

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Marcus speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I'm Rhys Oyelaran. I sent a transfer for my rent and it arrived days late. My landlord charged me for paying late, and honestly I'm really unhappy with how Thistle Bank has handled this.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry that's happened, Rhys. I can look into the transfer for you. Before we discuss the account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that's all verified. I appreciate how frustrating this must be. We'll get the transfer charge refunded for you, and I'll check what happened.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It was £1,240, sent on the 3rd of October. It didn't reach my landlord until the 7th.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I'll put a note on your account about the delay and the rent charge. Do you know how much the landlord charged?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: £45. I want to know why it took so long, and I don't want this just brushed aside.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course, Rhys. I'll take ownership of it. I'll send this to our payments team today, and I'll contact you by Friday the 24th of October with an update on the transfer and the £45 charge.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: We'll investigate the payment and send you a full written response within 15 business days. I'll make sure the payments team has the details you've given me, and I'll follow up with you by the 24th, even if the investigation isn't complete by then.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I still think the delay was unacceptable.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand, and I'm sorry you've had this experience. Just to summarise, I'll refer the late transfer and £45 charge to the payments team today, contact you by the 24th of October, and you'll receive a full written response within 15 business days. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, Rhys. I'll make sure it's followed up. Is there anything else I can help with today?
